content: Talik didimeniŋ gineŋ Bepaŋ niutumbadok
Bepaŋ adi saŋiniŋ molom, adigoŋ Yahwe, doktiŋa indiŋ yoŋa kwet wapum i hatakneŋ metam hatiiŋ hogohogok, mele labulabuneŋkade tububihila wooŋ mele fofoŋ tilakneŋkade kutiyehimanelak.
Bepaŋ adi Saiyon uŋoŋ yokwet momooŋ tiŋa uŋgoniŋ hinek gineŋ uŋoŋ hatilak. Kaŋ hautaŋiŋdi miŋgilaŋgoŋ mintalak.
Bepaŋnik adi agaŋ bulak, iŋgoŋ adi kabup mu bulak. Mokoŋ. Adi yadi kudup nemenemek dadapmaŋ titiŋdok wendi talikom timilak, eŋ fifiŋgobutdi tumulune bulak.
Adi metamŋiye’walaŋ titiŋhik diniŋ mebi didimeŋgoŋ kanadi tilak u sigiyakadi tidemeek yoŋa kunum gut kwet kutiyenilak.
Bepaŋdi indiŋ yolak, “Metamneye hidi nutok dumuŋ hemundumunduŋe tinamuŋa nukut kifolok tugumun. Hidi buŋa nukut bopneneŋ.”
Kunumdi indiŋ yohautalak, “Bepaŋ adi didimeniŋ hinek, tiŋa ne kubugoŋdi mede nadinadi kwanai tilak.”
Bepaŋdi indiŋ yolak, “Metamneye, hidi indiŋ nadineŋ. Isilaehi hidi mede foloŋ hapmewit, nu kubugoŋdi Bepaŋ hinek tiŋa undugoŋ hidi’walaŋ Bepaŋhik.
Nu adi hidi dumuŋ heiŋ be kale kudup foloŋ hemundumunduŋe tiiŋ wendoktiŋa mu hanintolat.
Nu adi hidi’walaŋ gimbahaŋhik gineŋ makau maaniŋ be meme maaniŋ mu yanagitdok nadilat.
Kale moihi behepneŋ hatiiŋ be makau kweboboe hogohogok foloŋ hatiiŋ adi yadi na’walaŋ hogohogok.
Eŋ bagi moihi be kale tiŋa kaleŋgiŋgiŋ yupaneŋ hatiiŋ hogohogok u maaŋ na’walaŋ hogok.
“Kwet wapum yendok foloŋ nemenemek hakiiŋ hogohogok woŋ adi na’walaŋ hogok. Unduŋ doktiŋa nu map nadiŋa hidi tuwot mu haninadiwit.
Nu makau gomŋiŋ maaŋbe nalat? Be meme naŋgatŋiŋ maaŋbe silotnalat? U mokoŋ.
Hidi naniutumba tineŋ, kaŋ wendi siloŋ tinamiiŋ tibek. Tiŋa nemek siloŋ titiŋdok yofafaŋegiŋ hogohogok u Bepaŋ loloŋnit nutok hogok siloŋ tinamneŋ.
Hidi unduŋ tineŋ, ala malabumuŋ mintahambune kaŋ nu kedem kutinaniyaneeŋ. Kaŋ nu kedem hehitubu-lodaluwaat, kaŋ hidi nu wotnene nanintiloneeŋ.”
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋdi me kadakahidok adi indiŋ yenilak, “Hidi dediŋ doktiŋa nu’walaŋ Yodoko Medene u folooŋbo yooŋ kilikibo yooŋ tiiŋ? Tiŋa undugoŋ, dediŋ doktiŋa folofolokne diniŋ mede hogok yofit tiiŋ.
Hidi adi nu hehitubu-didimedok moŋ yoŋa helemahelemaŋ mane mede ukiiŋ.
Hidi adi kubome heki yabuŋa adigut menot momooŋ tiiŋ. Tiŋa metam kikabi tiiŋ hekidut yauŋa kefifile tiyawiiŋ.
Hidi adi helemahelemaŋ medehaki tiŋa mede yalaŋ yoiŋ.
Tiŋa hidi dahiye be kwayahiye yenimunumunuŋe tiŋa yalaŋ yoŋa yeniŋkadaka tiiŋ.
Hidi unduŋ tiiŋ kaŋ nu mede nemu yolat, doktiŋa nu adi hide nabugoŋ unduŋ yoŋa nadiiŋ. Iŋgoŋ mokoŋ hinek. Nu adi kamiŋ namandahik foloŋgoŋ hanintoŋa hanindidimelat.
“Metam sigilulum tinamiiŋ, hidi mede i nadihinaka hinek tineŋ. Hidi undiniŋ hogok hati tineeŋ adi hehitubu-kadaka tibaat, kaŋ nebek niŋdi kotigoŋ tuwot mu hanagilaak.
Me nediyeŋ naniutumba tilak adi yadi siloŋ tinamulak, tiŋa wotnene nanintilolak. Ale nu adi metam nediyeŋ medene tagimneiŋ heki adi hogok kotigoŋ yanagilaat.”
